name: @yunari/host
description: PC host: CLI launcher, static serving, sample transport and hardware providers.
//: Runtime dependencies are few, deliberately. Serving is node:http (and node:https for the secure origin), the sample stream is Server-Sent Events over that same server rather than a `ws` dependency (telemetry is push-only, so WebSocket's bidirectionality would be unused), and baseline telemetry is node:os. node-forge is the one addition: the host issues its own local CA (docs/decisions/0070), and Node can key and sign a certificate but cannot encode one. @types/* are types-only and never ship. Adding a runtime dependency here needs a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md entry first (AGENTS.md, "Dependencies").
